suggestions.title: Set a recovery key
suggestions.why: A recovery key is split into shares, any K of which rebuild it, so that the state can still be opened when every member has lost their key. Give each share to a different person, offline. Whoever holds K shares can open the state, so K is a decision about whom to trust together.
